itemized.notes: Scanned handwritten filing. Steve Farrell, County Council Seat A (at large), GOP, Midway. THE PORTAL LABEL AND THE FORM DISAGREE, as this module already documents: the file is published as the Elimination Report, and the form has BOTH the Partisan Convention Report box AND the Candidate Withdrawal/Disqualification/Elimination box checked. Recorded as observed; not resolved here. Signed 6/16/2026. THE $1.00 DELTA IS THE FILER'S, AND IT IS THE ONE THING A HUMAN MAY WANT TO SEE. The two amounts (266.00 and 52.00) are written twice each — once on Table A, once on Table B — and I re-read every instance at 600 dpi and then at 1200 dpi. 266.00 is unambiguous (the two 6s are identical closed loops; a 5 in this hand has a flat top bar and open bowl, nothing like them). The second amount's middle glyph was the doubtful one: at 600 dpi on Table A it could pass for a 7, but the 1200 dpi read of the Table B instance shows the flat baseline stroke of a 2 clearly, and both instances are the same shape. So the rows are 266.00 and 52.00. Under gate (c) I checked whether any single-digit alternative closes the printed total: 265.00 + 52.00 would give exactly 317.00, but the '6' is not a doubtful glyph, and 266.00 + 57.00 = 323.00 is worse. Since no doubtful reading closes the identity, arithmetic gives no help and the glyph read stands with the delta recorded — exactly the honest-delta case, not a Rhodes-rule case. The filer added 266 + 52 as 317. Table A row slot 0 carries a struck-through scribble in the DATE cell with the name, amount and in-kind cells all empty; nothing survives the strikeout, so it is not emitted as a row (noted, per the module's strikeout rule). Both dates are written as 'Jan 8' and 'Mar 30' with NO YEAR — left BLANK per the date rule, verbatim in the row notes; the year is never filled from the 2026 report date. Table A's In-Kind column is filled ('Filing Fee', 'Printing'), so in_kind is set true from the column as printed per gate (g), with the caveat that the filer may be using it to state the PURPOSE of a self-funded cash contribution rather than a tangible in-kind good — the matching Table B rows spend the same amounts on the same things. Form prints no address column, so donor_city/donor_state are blank by design.
